verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents JWT-based delegated access for users (appwrite-docs-35) and a permissions-based database/resource model (appwrite-docs-6, appwrite-docs-23), which could underpin least-privilege credentialing, but there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped API keys/tokens specifically for AI agents. missing for 10: explicit docs on creating agent-specific scoped API keys, examples of least-privilege key scoping for MCP/agent use, and independent confirmation this works in practice for agent credentials.
